slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.58% today to 7,591.70 as surging oil prices, now at $103.38 a barrel for US crude, pushed bond yields higher and made investors worry the Fed will raise interest rates. The 10-year Treasury yield, which is what the US government pays to borrow money for a decade, climbed to 4.94%, its highest level in some time, squeezing stock valuations across the board. Gold fell 1.31% and silver dropped 5.66%, both hurt by a stronger dollar and rising rate expectations. Tomorrow's CPI inflation report is the next big test: if consumer prices come in hot, rate hike odds will rise further.
